forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we will send you a code to reset it.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has a Taskly account, we sent it an email with a password reset code. The code expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.notReceived: Didn't get it? Check spam, or
forgot.mailUnavailable: We could not send the email right now, please try again in a few minutes

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Paste the code from the email and enter a new password.
reset.success: Your password has been reset. Please log in with the new password.
reset.codeRequired: Please paste the code from the email
reset.codeInvalid: This code is not valid, please check the email again
reset.codeExpired: This code has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.
